content.text:
I added `GET /api/messages/{id}` in `src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts`, backed by a new `getForRecipient` query in `src/repos/messages.ts`. The query filters on `recipient_user_id = caller` and selects only the needed columns. Everyone else gets 404: other users, admins, the sender, other practices and unknown ids. Unauthenticated requests get 401. The recipient gets exactly `{id, subject, body, sentAt, from:{name}}`, and `read_at` is set on open.

Each read is audited as `message.read` by id only, and nothing is logged. I added tests for these cases in `tests/messages.test.ts`, and `npm run verify` passes.

The task's data decisions were all settled, so I made no restrictive-option choices. One caveat: I read `README.md`'s rules only through `CLAUDE.md`, which I assumed covers them.
